Lillördag Wednesday Night Ride

Costa Mesa, CA · Social

Beginner friendly

Lillördag Wednesday Night Ride is a social group ride in Costa Mesa, CA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Lions Park. Pace: mostly flat, social pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mostly flat, social pace.
Check
Look at @cmbetterstreets the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lillördag Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A flat, social-pace ride around Costa Mesa. All bikes and abilities welcome. Listed on the Costa Mesa Alliance for Better Streets events page, along with a Saturday 10:00 am coffee ride from Newport Beach.
